context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 133 tested the NEW async background Claude Opus 4.6 enrichment flow. Key difference from iteration 132 (sync version): capture now returns immediately (~2-3 seconds) and Claude enrichment runs in a background thread, updating the record 5-10 seconds later. Key functions: _fire_and_forget() (lines 530-540), _background_claude_enrich() (lines 543-638) in /app/backend/routes/extension.py. The background function uses pymongo (sync) instead of motor (async) because motor clients are bound to specific event loops. Fields populated by background enrichment: current_salary, expected_salary, notice_period, notice_period_days, current_employer, designation, skills, phone, email, ai_enriched_at, ai_enrichment_source.
